basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate (કલેકટર અને જિલ્લા મેજીસ્ટ્રેટની કચેરી), Navsari, will form a panel for 6 posts at the Navsari District Court: 5 Additional Public Prosecutor posts and 1 Woman Public Prosecutor post for the Special POCSO Court. Law graduates who have been active advocates for at least seven years can apply. The application form must be sent by Speed Post only and must reach the District Magistrate's office in Navsari by 19 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Navsari Collector Office
content_sections.text: The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Navsari, issues this notice through its Magistrate Branch at Jilla Seva Sadan, Kaliyawadi, Navsari, Gujarat. The panel is being formed because the Home Department of Gujarat issued instructions in circular no. HD/MIS/e-file/8/2026/3525/I-1, dated 17/07/2026. The panel will be prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and the Prosecuting Officer (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules-2025. The notice is signed by Manish Gurwani, District Magistrate, Navsari.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the office website, https://navsari.nic.in/forms/ . The same form is also printed with the notice. Fill in every detail and attach the documents listed under Enclosures. Send the form by Speed Post only to this postal address: Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Magistrate Branch, Jilla Seva Sadan, 1st Floor, Kaliyawadi, Navsari-396427. The form must reach the office by 19 November 2026 at the latest. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope. The office phone number is 02637-246099 and its e-mail is [email protected] . The e-mail address is a contact address only; applications go by Speed Post. The form is addressed to the District Magistrate, with the subject "Appointment of Additional Public Prosecutor". It asks for the following details: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the form and sign across it. Sign the form, and write the date and place at the end.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The Woman Public Prosecutor post is for the Special POCSO Court. The notice names it as a post for a woman public prosecutor. The notice gives the following conditions for applicants to both posts: Applications are invited from law graduates. The applicant must have been active as an advocate for at least seven years. The applicant must have been an income tax payer for at least 3 years before the appointment. The applicant must be not less than 30 years and not more than 55 years old. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age, and it lists no age relaxation. An appointed prosecutor may serve up to a maximum age of 60 years. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

rows.pay: Fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officer (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules-2025
Fees and other allowances as per the same Rules-2025

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: An attested copy of your date of birth proof. Attested copies of your experience certificates. Attested copies of your educational qualification certificates. Copies of your income tax returns for the last three years. A copy of your Sanad (enrolment as an advocate under the Advocates Act, 1961). A certificate from the court where you started practice. Attested proof of any other qualification. A recent passport-size photograph, pasted on the form and signed. The form ends with a list of enclosures, with ten numbered rows. Write the details of each attested copy you attach in that list.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed on a panel. Candidates called for an interview must attend at their own cost on the date, time and place given to them, and must bring their original certificates. The notice gives no other selection stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in Navsari Collector Office Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts in total: 5 Additional Public Prosecutor posts and 1 Woman Public Prosecutor post for the Special POCSO Court at the Navsari District Court.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Navsari Additional Public Prosecutor posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Navsari, by Speed Post by 19 November 2026. Applications received late will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Navsari Additional Public Prosecutor posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be law graduates who have been active as advocates for at least seven years. They must also have been income tax payers for at least 3 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Navsari Public Prosecutor panel?
faq.answer: Applicants must be not less than 30 years and not more than 55 years old. An appointed prosecutor may serve up to a maximum age of 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Navsari Additional Public Prosecutor posts?
faq.answer: Appointed prosecutors get fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officer (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules-2025.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Navsari APP recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://navsari.nic.in/forms/ and fill in all details. Attach the required documents and send it by Speed Post only to Magistrate Branch, Jilla Seva Sadan, 1st Floor, Kaliyawadi, Navsari-396427.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Navsari Public Prosecutor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates called for an interview must attend at their own cost, with their original certificates, on the fixed date, time and place.

faq.question: Q8. Which court is the Woman Public Prosecutor post for?
faq.answer: The Woman Public Prosecutor post is for the Special POCSO Court in Navsari district.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to attach income tax returns with the Navsari APP application?
faq.answer: Yes. Copies of your filed income tax returns for the last three years must be attached, and the form asks for your year-wise income and income tax details.
